request.result: Partially executed; migration and setup passed; real product_db first-screen E2E blocked by Rust partial analysis; S2 remains in progress
request.summary: Connected physical MQS7N19402011743 to the actual external Codex IPC host through the repo local Node service, explicitly enabled history range v3, backed up original app/data, rehearsed the actual v4 cache copy migration to v5, built a compatible rollback APK, installed the current app, and observed real completed surface and its automatically admitted single Rust collection chain. Selected user-supplied conversation 01a0ee04-a775-72b3-bd07-04aac804a3b4 produced 21 unsupported token_usage_record and 3 non_visible developer-message UnknownEvents; analysis remained partial and Node correctly did not publish canonical product rows. Real command and cwd were visible on Android via IPC, not product_db. No product source mutation or formal review.

commands.observation: BUILD SUCCESSFUL; current S1 APK built and later installed while preserving original app data

commands.observation: Original v4 cache with 89 items and APK backed up before upgrade; SHA256 and byte lengths preserved in sanitized evidence

commands.command: JDK21 gradlew with rollback.init.gradle, quoted -Ps2AppId=com.termlink.app.s2rehearsal assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest
commands.observation: Initial unquoted dotted Gradle property parsed as a task and failed; corrected quoted property succeeded. Isolated rehearsal uses current exact cache helper/schema/wire over pre-S1 Android main source.

commands.command: adb -s MQS7N19402011743 shell am instrument -w -r -e class com.termlink.app.codex.data.Task005S2CacheMigrationRehearsalTest,com.termlink.app.codex.data.CodexHistoryCacheMigrationInstrumentationTest com.termlink.app.s2rehearsal.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
commands.observation: OK (11 tests), actual physical execution. Actual v4 copy migrated to v5, all old table values and 89 items preserved, reopened successfully; ten existing cache instrumentation tests also passed.

commands.command: JDK21 gradlew -I <absolute rollback.init.gradle> -Ps2AppId=com.termlink.app assembleDebug
commands.observation: First relative init path resolved under android and failed; absolute path succeeded. rollback-compatible-v5.apk built; not installed or claimed as a tested full rollback.

commands.command: install-debug-apk.ps1 -Serial MQS7N19402011743 -ProjectRoot <repo> -SkipLaunch; install one-time device setup test APK; am instrument Task005S2SmokeSetupTest
commands.observation: One setup test passed; separate local profile created, existing profiles retained, schema 5 opened. Setup pass is not an E2E verdict.

commands.command: Real authenticated Gateway set_active_conversation for user-supplied completed conversation; open same conversation using Android Task History; inspect existing server/analyzer/SQLite state read-only

commands.command: Android UI hierarchy and existing CodexViewModel logcat; current copied SQLite integrity/schema/count inspection
commands.observation: Healthy IPC authority observed for selected completed conversation. Tool command git status --short --branch; git diff --stat and tool cwd E:\coding\LawAgent were visible; their source is IPC. Original cache rows=89; schema=5; integrity=ok.

commands.command: adb uninstall only temporary com.termlink.app.s2rehearsal.test, com.termlink.app.s2rehearsal, com.termlink.app.test
